notes.title: Star Wars™ Pinball VR is finally here! Get on the leaderboards today!
notes.content:
Hey VR Pinball Pals!

Check out our brand new game, [b][i]Star Wars™[/i] Pinball VR, which is now available [/b]to play on Steam VR! Jump into a galaxy far, far away once again, and immerse yourself in virtual reality pinball!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1530770?utm_source=steam&utm_medium_PFX2VR

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39942376/6eddff33588b7825bf28612e0254176a9a861244.png[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]The “Fan Cave”[/b]: The new home for your pinball table, plus the customizable array of Star Wars lightsabers, blasters, helmets, and more you’ll earn while playing. Start up a new table and life-sized characters and vehicles join you on either side.
[*][b] The Mandalorian[/b]: The excitement of the first season translated into VR pinball goodness. Take bounties, protect the Child, and meet characters like IG-11 or Moff Gideon. 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39942376/542fed09cc0927bf1b1c2cf59df30aa80614ea3f.png[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]Total Immersion Mode[/b]: Stand side-by-side with your favorite characters and experience everything at table level.
[*] [b]Full 360-Degree Mini-Games[/b]: Dive into iconic Star Wars set pieces like the speeder bike chase on Endor, the Bespin carbon-freezing chamber duel, and others.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39942376/caccc229c3c425bbafe53f7506d140e3034fd75d.png[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]Career Mode[/b]: Play bite-sized challenges designed to make you a better player! Progress through missions, and become the ultimate pinball wizard. 
[/list]

In addition, enjoy classic [i]Star Wars™ [/i]Pinball features like Force powers, competitive gameplay, haptic controller feedback, your own personal cantina jukebox, and more!

The only thing you need to do now is don your VR headset, press play, and start getting those jackpots! 

The Zen Team

notes.title: The Pinball FX2 Ultimate Edition
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We have some great news for you: if you ever wanted to dive into the breathtaking world of Pinball FX2 VR, Christmas came early for you! Let us introduce the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/12566/Pinball_FX2_VR_Ultimate_Edition/]Pinball FX2 VR Ultimate Edition[/url], a package of Zen's greatest original tables.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/12566/Pinball_FX2_VR_Ultimate_Edition/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26935726/9c1c12eaa2b3e1b9e28149d0a33646d89d2b0da9.png[/img][/url]

Let's see what this edition has to offer:

- Base Game: Dive deep into the ocean, surrounded by creatures of the depths in “Secrets of the Deep,” embark on a journey in a classical fantasy setting, accompanied by a friendly knight in “Epic Quest,” or lead humanity to a new frontier and help mankind explore “Mars”!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/OQoKps0.gif[/img]

- Season 1 Pack: Experience five fan-favorite tables recreated for virtual reality! Storm the gates of your enemy’s castle with Sir Gareth on the “CastleStorm” table, take part in a true western showdown in “Wild West Rampage,” achieve groundbreaking scientific results in “BioLab,” investigate a series of supernatural events in “Paranormal,” and repel the invading alien forces in “Earth Defense”!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/IGKS9Di.jpg[/img]

Sounds great, doesn't it?

If VR Pinball is on your bucket list, this is Christmas in early November: grab the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/12566/Pinball_FX2_VR_Ultimate_Edition/]Pinball FX2 Ultimate Edition[/url]!

See you on the (virtual) leaderboards!

notes.title: Pinball FX2 VR - 1.0.3 Patch notes
notes.content:
A new patch went live fixing some environment sound effects and a bunch more minor issues on Steam VR. 

We hope you’ll enjoy the fix and continue to have a great VR experience! 

Patch notes:
- Minor bug fixes.
- Fixed the environment sound volume issue on the Back To The Future table.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26935726/11f419fe5c88431c62795634c0a424251a0a6ecd.png[/img]
